about: CP1 (s07 art plan section CP1, CHAI-08): the chai pan seen straight down, flat, tipped 15, 30 and 45 degrees, then pouring milk chai and black tea; cut by shape (cut_shaped: never keyed off its dark ground), registered by the rim's circle onto one canvas, into assets/cook/items/chai-v2/. The chai tray's pour (js/cook/stations/chai-tray.js) steps through the tilts before the stream; data/cook.json art.s02 chai-pan-tilt-* and chai-pan-pour-* carry the files and the lip.
